column8: Primary domain drexel.edu (also servicedesk.drexel.edu, library.drexel.edu); no system office. Absences: IT Acceptable Use web page (drexel.edu/it/computers-software/acceptable-use/, published 2025-03-07) carries no AI language; Graduate College Academic Policies, Procedures and Guidelines page (published 2025-12-05) carries no AI language; College of Computing & Informatics Conduct Policy (published 2023-05-02) carries no AI language. Blocked: Drexel Official Policy Catalog on drexel0.sharepoint.com (PO-05 Academic Integrity, PO-103 official copy, IT-01 Acceptable Use, IT-08 Information Security, proposed Faculty Usage of GAI Tools policy) not fetchable (allowlist); drexel.edu/cpo/policies/ and drexel.edu/it/about/policies/tos/chatgpt/ refused by allowlist. Announced: Standing Committee on AI (SCAI) charge with no report; draft Faculty Usage of GAI Tools policy (proposed, unread). Excluded: AI Policies repository page (drexel.edu/provost/ai/pedagogy-guidance/policies, published 2025-08-25, modified 2026-05-12) is a link hub with no rule; servicedesk KB 20196 'ChatGPT Edu Resources for Getting Started' (2026-01-13, modified 2026-10-29) is a training list with no governance text; SCAI About page used only as source of announced row; news items (Feb 2026 Molina EdTech in-the-news, Feb 2024 AI Safety Consortium) out of scope; The Triangle and trinka.ai aggregator ignored. Not fetched within budget: TLC teaching tips 'Developing an AI Course Policy in the Age of ChatGPT' (Sept 2023) and 'Opposite of Cheating' (April 2026); SCAI committee-members page; LeBow 'Using Microsoft Copilot for Access to Generative AI' KB; Faculty Senate site (search returned no Drexel senate AI action); Drexel Online unit; catalog academic integrity text; admissions (search found no AI application guidance).

No Academic Council resolution located by search. Announced without document: Faculty Senate Spring 2025 action requiring syllabus AI policy (cited by Stearns Center, not located on facultysenate.gmu.edu). Syllabus template DOCX unreadable (binary). Excluded: GMU news 'New Academic Standards Code...' (2025-08-22) quotes no institutional AI rule; Faculty Senate July 2025 resolution (federal government matters, not AI per title/agenda context, not fetched); Shehu appointment news (2024-09) and gmu.edu/AI initiative hub (research/strategy, not fetched); trinka.ai and ibl.ai aggregator items ignored. Stearns Center home page fetched: AI programs (Teaching with AI credential, CORE+AI Design) with no rule text. Not fetched within budget: graduate division (search found no GMU thesis AI policy), Office of Digital Learning, student conduct office, ITS policy library beyond AI Toolkit, PatriotAI launch announcement, 2025 syllabus template and elements checklist.

Not fetched within budget: graduate programs/thesis guidance, GW Online, Law School and SMHS own integrity codes (excluded from provost guidance), library.gwu.edu/teaching-generative-ai.

No separate state system office. Steps 2a-g run with site:iu.edu plus unrestricted; string c and d site searches returned no IU results. ABSENCES: IU Bloomington Enrollment and Student Academic Information Bulletin, 'Misconduct Policies' (https://bulletin.indiana.edu/policies/academic-misconduct.html, undated, copyright 2026) carries no AI language; School of Education Undergraduate Bulletin 2025-2026 student conduct page carries no AI language. Teaching.IU itself states "IU does not currently have any specific policies around the use of generative AI". The Task Force report's proposed Student Code revision on GenAI could not be confirmed as adopted. ACCESS: studentcode.iu.edu/responsibilities/academic-misconduct.html (recorded as Not reachable row; CITL reports it names artificial intelligence as unauthorized external assistance), CITL ai-generated-text page, VPFAA start-of-semester page, and servicenow.iu.edu KB articles (KB0026507 approved-tools list, KB0026800 ChatGPT Edu, KB0025888 Copilot, KB0025830) blocked by fetch allowlist (Not reachable; not recorded as separate rows except where noted). ANNOUNCED: institution-wide AI roadmap under Lilly Endowment planning grant (row recorded). Task force report recommended ethical-use guidelines; no published guidelines located. EXCLUDED: ai.iu.edu GenAI task force page (descriptive duplicate of UFC report); UFC committee page (descriptive; quoted in notes); Kelley AI Resources Gateway (not fetched); trinka.ai aggregator entries; IDS News student press items. NOT FETCHED within budget: Bloomington Faculty Council (bfc.indiana.edu) AI actions (search returned none), University Graduate School AI guidance (search returned none), IU Libraries AI guide (search returned none), IU Online unit, provost page (vpfaa.indiana.edu), today.iu.edu item 47297. Count of 15 includes the Student Code Not reachable row and excludes the Announced row (16 rows total). Rows added after IU Indianapolis searching surfaced IU-wide KB articles bigz and bimt, the Bloomington CITL page, and College intranet syllabus guidance.

IU-wide documents (Task Force report, UFC charge, KB biit/bigz/bimt, Data Management FAQ, UITS AI hub, Teaching.IU, Learning.IU, ai.iu.edu, ChatGPT Edu announcement, Student Code, IU AI roadmap announcement, Kelley AI Playbook which covers Kelley Indianapolis) recorded once under 151351 Bloomington, not duplicated here. Task force co-chair Kevin Jones is from IUPUI. Steps 2a-g run with site:indianapolis.iu.edu plus unrestricted 'IU Indianapolis AI policy'; strings c-f returned only IU-wide items. ABSENCES: Faculty & Staff Central 'Academic Misconduct' (Enrollment Management, Academic Policies and Procedures; undated, copyright 2026) carries no AI language; Student Central (studentcentral.iupui.edu) 'Academic Misconduct' page (undated, no office named) carries no AI language. Artificial Intelligence and Informatics Consortium (AI2) page is a research-consortium page with no use provisions (excluded). ANNOUNCED: provost GenAI listening sessions on student-use policy (row recorded). No IU Indianapolis Faculty Council AI action located by search. NOT FETCHED within budget: IU Indianapolis Faculty Council site, University Library AI guide (search returned none), Graduate Office, IU Online. Excluded aggregator entries (trinka.ai IUPUI).

REGENTS (Step 4): site:iowaregents.edu search returned one AI item, 'University Presentation: Artificial Intelligence Opportunities and Challenges' (Academic Affairs Committee, June 13-14, 2023; https://iowaregents.edu/media/cms/0623_AAC_6__AI_Presentation_B62000CAA7FB0.pdf): descriptive faculty presentation, action 'Receive the presentation', no governance language, excluded; plus an ISU MS in AI program proposal (degree approval, excluded). No Regents AI policy located. State of Iowa DOM 'Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) Policy' (policies.iowa.gov) is a state executive-branch policy, not ISU or Regents, excluded. ANNOUNCED: 2024 Generative AI Guidance Committee (ITS) and GenAI Teaching and Learning Committee (row recorded).
